title: Status properties/LoseControl
html:
See also Status properties.

LoseControl is a status property.

List of conditions with LoseControl

Condition Effects
Befuddled
  • Affected entity can't control its actions and wanders around without direction.
Berserk
  • A frenetic rage racks the affected entity's flesh. Its Multiattacks each deal an additional 1d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage and knocks targets  Prone
  • It also gains Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage, and has  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
  • This frenzy ends if the affected entity regains all its hit points.
Champion Challenge
  • Affected entity is compelled to attack the paladin that challenged them. Any attacks they might make against targets other than the paladin have  Disadvantage.
  • Condition ends if the entity moves 9 m (30 ft) away from the paladin.
Coerced
  • Forced to fight for Nere and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic each turn.
  • Ends upon taking any non-Psychic damage.
Command: Approach
  • Has to move toward the spellcaster using the shortest route possible.
  • Cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Compelled Duel
  • Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against anyone but the caster.
Compelled to Duel
  • Has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against anyone but the caster. Might start  Bleeding if struck by the Dueller.
Confused
  • Affected entity is hostile to everyone, wanders around aimlessly, and occasionally skips turns in its stupor
Crown of Madness
  • Instilled with magical madness. Will attack the nearest creature, other than the spellcaster.
Demonspirit Madness
  • Affected entity has been driven to a frenzy by magical madness. It will attack the nearest creature on its turn.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a  Wisdom Saving Throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.
Dominated
  • Affected entity will follow and fight alongside the caster of this spell.
  • Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful Wisdom  Saving Throw.
Dominated
  • Affected entity will follow and fight alongside the caster of this spell.
  • Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful Wisdom  Saving Throw.
Gnawing Horde
  • Ravenous Ghouls that fight alongside you.
Goaded
  • Must attack the goading creature, if possible.
  •  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against targets other than the spellcaster.
Hag's Pawn
  • Ethel has taken control. Condition lasts until mask is removed or spellcaster is dead.
Incubus Charmed
  • You are charmed by a devil and must support it in battle. You can make another Saving Throw against this effect after taking damage.
Insanity's Kiss
  • Hostile to all other creatures for the condition's duration.
Lured
  • The affected entity is attracted to a harpy's luring melody and uses its turn to move closer to the harpy, possibly provoking opportunity attacks from the other harpies.
  • The affected entity must pass a  DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of their turn or remain lured.
  • Taking damage or being Shoved removes the condition.
Madness
  • Hostile to everyone in the vicinity.
Malefic Possession
  • The affected entity acts according to the  Possessing ghost's will and takes 4d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage each turn until it dies or is  Turned.
Mind Mastery
  • Forced to make a weapon attack against one of its allies by a duergar mind master.
  • Ends after the attack, or when hit.
Newborn Zombie
  • Zombies born from the Crawling Gnaw cannot last. They take 1⁠⁠Necrotic each turn and only follow the zombie that infected them.
On Black Wings
  • An unkindness of ravens that will act of their own accord.
Seized by Planar Binding
  • Affected entity follows and fights for the one who has bound it.
  • Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful  Wisdom Saving Throw.
Shadow Possession
  • Affected entity is possessed by frenzied shadows and will attack the nearest creature. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Shadow-Cursed Undead
  • Those who die in the shadows are cursed to remain there forever.
  • These undead have reduced Hit Points and Strength, are Resistant to ⁠Necrotic damage and cannot use Spells or Weapon Actions.
Unbridled Wrath
  • Releasing a decade of pent-up rage in a blaze of infernal fury.
  • The affected entity is Immune to Fire damage.
